<title id="_effe8c6c-a9d6-6d46-a9d5-cc507ef67954">2. The canonical snapshot</title>
<p id="_75cc9fee-d14e-02c3-ce87-b2427ff88ed9"> <tt>tebako registry snapshot &lt;alias|path&gt;</tt> renders every row of a registry document as ONE canonical line. Determinism is the premise — a snapshot that shifts when nothing changed is worthless as evidence:</p>

<sourcecode id="_e9233721-ef45-8c84-8395-7b871c872a44"> <body>&lt;kind&gt; &lt;name&gt;@&lt;version&gt; &lt;platform&gt; &lt;sha256|-&gt; &lt;state&gt; &lt;keyid|-&gt;</body> </sourcecode>
